title: Project stakeholders · Demo
description: Teach your student who a project affects, how to communicate with them, and when to revisit the plan. Three original practice questions; not an official PMP exam.

keyIdeas.text: Identify people or groups affected by the project or able to influence it, including people outside the delivery team.
Understand each stakeholder's needs and influence, then agree on useful information, a suitable communication channel, and timing. Invite feedback.
Revisit stakeholders and the engagement plan throughout the project, especially when scope, people, or needs change. Update the plan using feedback.

misconceptions: Only the sponsor and delivery team are project stakeholders.
Sending the same detailed report to everyone meets all communication needs.
The stakeholder list and engagement plan are fixed after project kickoff.
